description: A small block (1 kg) on a string of length L = 1 m from a fixed point, given v0 = 6 m/s horizontally at the bottom. The string goes slack above the horizontal where cos φ = (2gL − v0²)/(3gL) (φ from the downward vertical); the block then flies freely until the string is taut again (an impact: prompt 04). The string is a nonlinear constraint: tests the drift projection and the slack event.
